name: learnings_sql
instructions: Decide if the user wants to view or delete learnings.
If viewing, set action to "list" and write a SELECT statement.
If deleting, set action to "delete" and write a DELETE statement.
If neither, set action to "none" and sql to an empty string.
Schema: learnings(id INTEGER, content TEXT, created_at TEXT).
SELECT id, content, created_at FROM learnings ORDER BY id ASC;
For delete, prefer deleting by id if user mentions it.
Return ONLY JSON with fields action and sql.
